controls.evidence: Complete native role census identifies this 3-of-5 Safe as DEFAULT_ADMIN, rewarder and blacklist manager and the timelock proposer. Owner identities are recorded; module pagination is empty with sentinel 0x1 and guard/module-guard slots zero. redistributeLockedAmount can burn/remint a restricted holder balance without increasing net supply; seizure and cooldown/loss powers remain adverse. The current exact implementation prevents this Safe from directly granting the upgrade role. Human signer independence is not asserted.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26107706, the UUPS implementation is 0x6561272e3ebc9f2e07cdb12b7c474db9132b977a. The current timelock 0xa952453e39f77108ee37c1b92de593f1c59a6ef4 holds TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE and has 86400-second minimum delay; the owner Safe is 3-of-5 with no enabled modules and zero guard slots. Admin cooldown, blacklist/seizure and reward loss-write-down powers are retained, not counted as bridge issuance. Full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay from proxy creation through block 26110187 and current hasRole checks resolve DEFAULT_ADMIN=0x0c6bbfd2d5666d44bf28580edeec0263692c8316, REWARDER=0x0c6bbfd2d5666d44bf28580edeec0263692c8316,0xa0c49ffa4b7941830235cde974d9b2a8420cd375, BLACKLIST_MANAGER=0x0c6bbfd2d5666d44bf28580edeec0263692c8316,0xb1e50b7a19b8f650a6ee77dc0ac52b88059fa169, TIMELOCK_ADMIN=0xa952453e39f77108ee37c1b92de593f1c59a6ef4. Timelock role replay/current getters resolve proposer 0x0c6bbfd2d5666d44bf28580edeec0263692c8316, executor 0x039e71e865a34bcaaebfc641291bec6517ea0ce7, canceller 0x60226cbb34445143e5f923abe2d42e5df852d065; delay=86400 seconds. Exact implementation blocks direct grantRole/revokeRole for TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE; the initialized role changes only through setTimelockAdmin guarded by its current holder. pendingDefaultAdmin is zero and defaultAdminDelay=86400. Sherlock and Nethermind reports include strUSD staking/access/oracle integration; both predate the September 2026 implementation, so deployed build equivalence is not claimed. Continuous critical bug bounty is up to $1M; it is not financial assurance.
